title: Insights
subtitle: Recorded sessions, tasks, and activity from your local ALTERA data.

filters.invalidCustomRange: Choose valid dates with the start on or before the end.
filters.compare: Compare with the previous equal-length period

overview.title: Overview
overview.focusTimeHint: From work sessions, not calendar plans

focus.title: Focus time
focus.description: A session's full duration is assigned to its local start date. Pause history by day is not stored.
focus.noData: No work sessions were recorded in this period.
focus.tableSummary: Show chart data as a table
focus.sessionStartNote: Sessions belong to the period by their start date. An active session uses its live timer.
focus.selectToFilter: Select a period by clicking one of the columns.

projects.timeDescription: Recorded session duration in the selected period.
projects.noTime: No project time was recorded in this period.
projects.activityDescription: From sessions and saved events in the selected period.
projects.noActivity: No activity recorded in this period
projects.withoutActivity: Active projects with no recorded activity

tasks.title: Task status
tasks.currentNote: Status and overdue counts show current state. Completion history uses task_completed events, then completedAt as a fallback.
tasks.noTasks: There are no tasks in the selected project yet.
tasks.completionTrendNote: Trend from saved completion events and completedAt dates for older records.
tasks.completionTrendEmpty: No task completion records are available for this range.
tasks.missingTimestamp: {{count}} completed tasks have no completion date and are excluded from the period metric.

activity.title: Recorded activity
activity.description: Each cell reflects work sessions and saved project or task events—not merely opening the app.
activity.noActivity: No work sessions or events were recorded in this period.

warnings.overlap: Overlapping sessions were found ({{count}} records). Their time was excluded to avoid inflating the total.

empty.title: Nothing to analyze yet
empty.description: Create a project or record a work session. Your insights will appear here automatically.

comparison.title: Period comparison
comparison.description: Equal local-calendar ranges are compared. Sessions updated after the previous range ended are excluded because pause history cannot reconstruct the past state.
comparison.noPercentage: percentage unavailable for a zero baseline

planning.title: Planned and actual time
planning.description: Planned time comes from calendar blocks; actual time comes from recorded work sessions. They remain separate.
planning.uncompleted: Blocks still planned after their end
planning.chartLabel: Comparison of planned and recorded work time
planning.sessionStartNote: Session time is assigned to its local start date.
planning.empty: There is no scheduled or recorded time in the selected range.
planning.tableSummary: Show chart values as a table
planning.noProjects: No calendar blocks or sessions are linked to projects.
planning.uncompletedNote: Counts past blocks still marked planned. This does not mean that no work took place.
planning.relationshipNote: Planned and actual time are not matched by overlapping dates. Only their separate totals are shown.

deepDive.title: Project: {{project}}
deepDive.description: Summary for the selected range and the current task state.
deepDive.noActivity: No saved project events are available for this range.

automatic.title: Data observations
automatic.description: Factual observations from explicit rules, without judgments or claims about causes.
automatic.empty: There is not enough data for observations yet.

messages.focus_change: Recorded work time is {{current}} in the current period and {{previous}} in the preceding equal-length period.
messages.project_inactivity: Project “{{project}}” had recorded activity in the previous period, but none in the current period.
messages.overdue_tasks: There are currently overdue open tasks: {{count}}.
messages.planning_gap: {{planned}} was scheduled in the calendar and {{actual}} was recorded in sessions. These totals are compared separately.
messages.project_concentration: Project “{{project}}” accounts for {{share}}% of recorded work time in this range.

export.title: Export analytics
export.localOnly: Created on this device; notes and attachments are excluded.

workspace.title: This week
workspace.summary: {{duration}} across {{sessions}} completed sessions · {{projects}} currently active projects
